name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 ファントムガンダム

description.ja: 炎 ゆ ら め く 「 幽 霊 （ フ ァ ン ト ム ） 」
description.en: A flickering "phantom" of flame.

description.ja: 待 望 の 初 キ ッ ト 化 ！ ―
description.en: The long-awaited first kit! ―

description.ja: 『機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム ゴースト』より、ファントムガンダムがコレクションに最適な1/144スケールＨＧシリーズに登場！
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Crossbone Gundam Ghost", Phantom Gundam is now available in the 1/144 Scale HG series, perfect for collection!

description.ja: 機体形状、カラーリングを忠実に再現。全身を覆う印象的な「ファントムライト」発動状態を再現できる専用エフェクトパーツが付属する他、
description.en: Faithfully reproduces the aircraft shape and coloring. In addition to special effect parts that can reproduce the activation state of the impressive "phantom light" that covers the whole body,

description.ja: 専用武装や変形機構を有する圧倒的ボリュームで商品化！
description.en: Commercialized with overwhelming volume with exclusive weapons and transformation mechanisms!

description.ja: ●　機体フォルム、カラーリングを新規造形で忠実に再現。
description.en: ● The aircraft form and coloring are faithfully reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ファントムガンダムの機体形状を洗練された抜群のプロポーションで立体化。
description.en: The Phantom Gundam's body shape is three-dimensionalized with sophisticated and outstanding proportions.

description.ja: 特徴的なカラーリングはパーツ分割により色分けを実現。
description.en: The characteristic coloring is realized by dividing the parts into different colors.

description.ja: 頭部や胸部レリーフをはじめ、腕部や脚部など各所の細部ディテールまでモールドとパーツ分割で再現。
description.en: The head and chest reliefs, as well as various details such as the arms and legs, are reproduced using molds and separate parts.

description.ja: グリーン、レッド、ホワイトのカラーリングは劇中イメージに忠実に再現。
description.en: The green, red, and white coloring is faithfully reproduced from the image in the play.

description.ja: ●　アクション性を追求した可動域を実現
description.en: ● Achieves a range of motion that pursues action.

description.ja: 計算された最新のHGフォーマットによる各部可動域やギミックを搭載。自由度の高いダイナミックなポージングが可能。
description.en: Equipped with a calculated range of motion and gimmicks for each part based on the latest HG format. Dynamic poses with a high degree of freedom are possible.

description.ja: 腕部
description.en: arm

description.ja: 肩口ロール軸と肘部の二重関節を採用し、フレキシブルな可動を実現。付属の平手パーツで劇中シーンを演出可能。
description.en: Adopts double joints at the shoulder roll axis and elbow to achieve flexible movement. You can create scenes from the play with the included open hand parts.

description.ja: 背部ウイング / サイドスカート
description.en: back wing/side skirt

description.ja: 背部ウイングは上下、左右へ展開できる多軸構造。スカート基部には２か所の可動ポイントを搭載。
description.en: The back wing has a multi-axis structure that can be deployed vertically and horizontally. There are two movable points at the base of the skirt.

description.ja: また、ヒートナイフの抜刀状態をパーツの差し替えで演出可能。
description.en: In addition, the unsheathed state of the heat knife can be created by replacing parts.

description.ja: 脚部
description.en: leg

description.ja: 股関節及び太もも部にロール軸を搭載。
description.en: Equipped with a roll axis in the hip joint and thigh.

description.ja: 膝関節も２重関節となり、つま先には上下可動軸を採用。ポージングに合わせた柔軟な表情付けが可能。
description.en: The knee joints are also double jointed, and the toes have vertical movable axes. Flexible expressions can be added to match the pose.

description.ja: ●　溢れ出す「ファントムライト」専用エフェクトパーツが付属
description.en: ● Comes with special effect parts for the overflowing "phantom light"

description.ja: 全身から溢れ出す「ファントムライト」発動状態をパーツの差し替えで再現できるクリアエフェクトパーツが付属。
description.en: Comes with clear effect parts that can be used to recreate the state in which the "phantom light" overflowing from the entire body is activated by replacing parts.

description.ja: 炎のようなゆらめきをモールド、表面形状、ゆらぎ形状で全身細部まで演出。
description.en: The mold, surface shape, and fluctuating shape create a flame-like shimmer throughout the entire body.

description.ja: 頭部パーツは「強制放熱モード」を差し替え式で演出可能。
description.en: The head parts can be replaced to create a "forced heat dissipation mode".

description.ja: 特徴的なフェイスマスクはモールド豊かに表現。
description.en: The characteristic face mask is expressed in a rich mold.

description.ja: さらに、フレイム・ソードを再現可能なエフェクトパーツも同梱。
description.en: Furthermore, effect parts that can reproduce the flame sword are also included.

description.ja: 斬撃エフェクトの２種類を再現。
description.en: Reproduces two types of slashing effects.

description.ja: ●　蜃気楼鳥（ミラージュ・ワゾー）形態へ変形機構を搭載
description.en: ● Equipped with a mechanism to transform into a mirage bird (Mirage Wazo) form.

description.ja: 惑星間巡航形態「蜃気楼鳥」への変形が可能。差し替えパーツによる変形方式を採用し、変形時のプロポーションを追求。
description.en: Can transform into interplanetary cruising form "Mirage Bird". Adopts a deformation method using replacement parts and pursues proportions when deformed.

description.ja: ファントムライト発動状態も再現可能。
description.en: Phantom light activation state can also be reproduced.

description.ja: 別売りのアクションベースと組み合わせて、蜃気楼鳥形態でディスプレイできる専用ジョイントも付属。
description.en: A special joint is also included that allows you to display it in mirage bird form by combining it with the action base (sold separately).
